about: Sources Civgraph fetched and compared figure by figure with its own contest files (origin web-check in data/database/election-provenance.json). checked is true only where every compared figure agreed; otherwise check and disagreements say what differed. Citations and comparison notes only: no text is copied from the sources. Read by scripts/build-election-provenance.mjs.

batches.note: The 203 contests that had no source: NI local government (ARK; one Irish News), NI Forum 1996 (ARK), Westminster by-elections and European 2019 (ARK), Dáil 2014 (electionsireland.org), ROI referendums (Department of Housing CSVs on data.gov.ie; electionsireland.org).

Republic of Ireland local elections (mainly 1985-2009, plus other years where pages existed), checked in a normal headless browser against electionsireland.org (the import source) and irelandelection.com (independent). Pages with no result table, or nothing to compare, are not recorded. BBC pages were not fetched: its robots.txt disallows the agent.
